common_gotchas: The generated output is meant to feed Environment Light COMP directly.
Do not insert further image processing between PreFilter Map TOP and the Environment Light use path.
Choose diffuse versus specular output to match the Environment Light slot being driven.

key_concepts: Uses spherical harmonics to generate pre-filtered environment maps.
Outputs either diffuse or specular maps intended for Environment Light COMP.
The generated map should feed Environment Light directly without intervening image processing.
Common TOP resolution and float-format choices affect lighting quality and GPU memory.
